details.title: Normal Cakes (1–2 Hour Express)
details.text: Baked 100% fresh on order! Delivered fast in 1–2 hours. Last delivery slot is 12:00 AM midnight.

details.title: Premium Cakes (4-Hour Delivery)
details.text: Baking starts at 8:00 AM. Delivered in 4 hours. Deliveries run from 1:00 PM to 12:00 AM midnight.

details.title: Same-Day Cutoff & Next-Day Slots
details.text: Place last order by 8:00 PM for delivery by 12:00 AM. Orders after 9:00 PM are booked for next-day 1:00 PM delivery.

details.title: 100% Freshly Baked Guarantee
details.text: We never store pre-made cakes. Every cake is freshly handcrafted after your order is confirmed.
